narrative: Four drivers move the FY2027 plan: freight volume, the CNR diesel price, the general rate increase (GRI) and the lag before the fuel surcharge catches up. A 15% diesel rise with a two-month lag costs €1.67M of EBITDA (6.2% → 5.6%); a 4% volume drop needs a GRI of about 4.8% to hold EBITDA at €18.8M.

signals.title: FY2027: diesel +15% with a two-month lag costs €1.67M of EBITDA
signals.source: SDP scenario model — FY2027 Budget base
signals.excerpt: Fuel cost rises €4.0M; the surcharge recovers €2.3M. EBITDA margin falls from 6.2% to 5.6%. A monthly CNR reset limits the hit to €1.2M.
